app_info.name: Aura
app_info.description: A personal AI assistant for daily life organization covering habits, tasks, expenses, health, and journaling.
app_info.styling_paradigm: Tailwind (NativeWind) or standard StyleSheet mapped to Tailwind values

typography.rules: Avoid Inter/Roboto. Use typographic tension by mixing a classic serif for emotional headers and a geometric sans for UI data.

cards.style: Flat design, bg-white, 1px border-border_subtle, rounded-[24px]. No drop shadows except for floating elements. Inner padding p-5 or p-6.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-background rounded-full py-4 px-6 font-medium text-base active:opacity-80 flex items-center justify-center
buttons.secondary: bg-surface_secondary text-text_primary rounded-full py-4 px-6 font-medium text-base border border-border_subtle
buttons.fab: absolute bottom-6 right-6 w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-primary flex items-center justify-center shadow-floating

chips.active: bg-primary text-white rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm
chips.inactive: bg-surface_secondary text-text_secondary rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm border border-border_subtle

ambient_listening_bar.style: h-12 rounded-full backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/70 border border-white/20 shadow-floating flex items-center px-4 overflow-hidden
ambient_listening_bar.animation: Inner background has an animated gradient translating horizontally using gradient_ai_pulse colors at 20% opacity.

bottom_navigation.style: Because 7 screens cannot fit gracefully in a standard bottom tab, implement a horizontally scrollable pill-shaped dock at the bottom OR use 5 main tabs: Home, Tasks, [AI FAB], Journal, More. The 'More' tab opens a beautifully animated bottom sheet containing Habits, Expenses, Health, Reminders.
bottom_navigation.container: bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-border_subtle pb-safe pt-2 px-4 flex flex-row justify-around items-center h-20

micro_animations.habit_check: Checkbox inner fill expands from center with a subtle bounce. Confetti particle effect (SVG) bursts around the card upon 100% completion.
micro_animations.ai_listening: When mic is active, an SVG ring around the floating mic button or the ambient bar scales and fades out repeatedly (sonar pulse).

elements.name: Header
elements.desc: Live clock (large serif font), greeting, and Current Mood emoji/selector.

elements.name: Daily Stats Overview
elements.desc: Horizontal scroll or 2x2 bento: Tasks Done (fraction), Habits %, Expenses Today, Water Glasses.

elements.name: Streak Counter
elements.desc: Flame icon with dynamic number, using accent_terracotta.

elements.name: Next Reminder Card
elements.desc: Prominent card taking full width. primary bg with light text to stand out.

2_tasks.layout: List layout with sticky top filter chips.

elements.name: Filter Chips
elements.desc: All / Pending / Done (Scrollable row).

elements.name: Task List
elements.desc: Cards with left border indicator for priority: Red (High), Yellow (Medium), Green (Low).

elements.name: FAB
elements.desc: Bottom right for adding a task.

elements.name: Daily Progress Ring
elements.desc: Large circular progress at the top. 100% triggers celebration.

elements.name: Habit Cards
elements.desc: 2 columns. Each card has a subtle icon, title (Gym, Work Block), and a large custom checkbox. Shows streak inside.

4_expenses.layout: Split layout: Top summary, bottom list.

elements.name: Total Card
elements.desc: Massive typography (JetBrains Mono) for INR daily total. E.g., '₹ 1,240.00'.

elements.name: Category Tags
elements.desc: Small badges on each list item (Food, Transport, etc).

elements.name: Payment Method
elements.desc: UPI/Cash indicators using subtle border chips.

elements.name: Water Tracker
elements.desc: 8 glass visual slots. Tap to fill. Blue/Sage accent.

elements.name: Calorie Counter
elements.desc: Linear progress bar. E.g., 1400 / 2200 kcal.

elements.name: Workout Toggle
elements.desc: Large switch or card that toggles 'Active Workout' state.

elements.name: Tabs
elements.desc: Upcoming / Past.

elements.name: Cards
elements.desc: Show time prominently. Repeat icon if recurring.

elements.name: Mood Selector
elements.desc: Great/Good/Okay/Low/Stressed row with distinct earthy colors.

elements.name: Free-write Area
elements.desc: Looks like an actual page. Uses the Cormorant Garamond font for the date header.

elements.name: Entry List
elements.desc: Past entries shown as minimalist cards with text truncation.

elements.name: Messages
elements.desc: User bubbles: background surface_secondary. AI bubbles: background transparent, text_primary. No bubble borders for AI to feel like a flowing conversation.

elements.name: Quick Questions
elements.desc: Horizontally scrolling chips at the bottom above input.

elements.name: Input Area
elements.desc: Text input + Persistent floating mic button next to it. TTS toggle (speaker icon) in header.

images.description: Rippling water surface with light reflections. Use this as a very low opacity (5-10%) background image overlay in the AI Memory screen or Home dashboard to give it a premium organic feel.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, nav items, habit checkboxes, habit cards, task rows, expense items, text inputs, mic button) MUST include a kebab-case role-based data-testid attribute. Examples: 'nav-home-tab', 'habit-check-gym', 'add-expense-button', 'ai-mic-toggle'.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Expo application. Map the provided Tailwind-style classes to NativeWind or standard RN StyleSheet. 'rounded-full' = borderRadius: 9999, etc.
Do NOT use generic purple or teal gradients. Strictly adhere to the Organic & Earthy color palette.

For the bottom navigation, use a custom tab bar implementation or use a 5-tab layout where the middle is a distinct AI FAB, and one tab is 'More' (opening a bottom sheet for the remaining screens). Do not cram 7 icons into a standard tab bar.
Implement the 'ambient listening bar' as an absolutely positioned, high-z-index view at the top of the screen (or just below the notch) that only appears or highlights when voice listening is active.
Utilize safe area insets to ensure content isn't clipped by notches or home indicators.
For icons, prefer Lucide React Native (lucide-react-native) or Phosphor Icons for a clean, consistent look.
